name: Replication Through Removable Media
summary: Adversaries may move onto systems, such as those separated from the enterprise network, by copying malware to removable media which is inserted into the control systems environment. The adversary may rely on unknowing trusted third parties, such as suppliers or contractors with access privileges, to introduce the removable media. strategies.name: Detection of Replication Through Removable Media

analytics.name: Analytic 1866
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Universal Serial Bus (USB) storage device insertion event on an Industrial Control System (ICS) engineering or Human-Machine Interface (HMI) workstation where the device's hardware identifier (ID) is not in the authorized USB allowlist, immediately followed by process execution from the removable drive's path. Documented as the primary infection vector for Stuxnet, which specifically targeted air-gapped Siemens engineering environments via infected USB drives. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset,…

analytics.name: Analytic 2127
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a mount event for removable storage media on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux asset, followed by execution of a binary from the mounted path within a short window. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2190
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a new device connecting to an Industrial Control System (ICS) network switch port that was previously unused or previously assigned to a different device Media Access Control (MAC) address immediately following physical access to the environment, with subsequent Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol traffic to field devices. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. analytics.name: Analytic 2228
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol file-transfer service such as Distributed Network Protocol 3 (DNP3) File Transfer Object or Internet Electrotechnical Commision (IEC) 61850 file service being used to place files on a field device from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, outside a scheduled maintenance window, where the transfer source is a device not previously enrolled.
